radiology_report:
Subject: Multiparametric MRI Prostate | Radboudumc
Date: 11 January 2021

Clinical context: Serum PSA currently measures 4.8 ng/mL, with a prior PI-RADS 4 classification.

FINDINGS:
Glandular dimensions total 90.82 mL. T2-weighted imaging isolates a discrete hypointense region within the left peripheral zone, spanning the mid-gland to the base, spanning roughly 14 by 9 mm. High b-value diffusion sequences show marked restriction, mirrored by hypointensity on the apparent diffusion coefficient map. Post-contrast dynamics highlight early, localized enhancement against the background peripheral tissue. The capsule remains intact without extraprostatic spread, seminal vesicle involvement, or nodal abnormalities. The prostatic urethra and bladder neck maintain normal patency.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 4 lesion in the left peripheral zone.
Prostate volume 90.82 mL yielding a PSA density of 0.053 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa predicted probability 0.46945655
